recent.text: Pelicans trail Grizzlies 105-86 after three. Memphis has put up 35 points in each quarter tonight. Outside of Saddiq Bey (25 PTS, 5-8 3s) and DeAndre Jordan, no other Pelican is shooting well from the field -- team has 37.7 FG% & 23.1 3PT%.

recent.text: Pelicans trail Grizzlies 70-58. New Orleans made only 3 of 16 from deep (Memphis: 10 of 20), and factor in 10 missed shots inside the restricted area, there's your deficit. Zion Williamson: 14 PTS, 4 REB Saddiq Bey: 14 PTS, 6 REB Jordan Poole: 9 PTS Jeremiah Fears: 8 PTS, 5 AST
